Root cause: APFS clonefile copies are logged as "Copied (server-side copy)" and rclone credits whole-file bytes only at completion, so every 1s NOTICE stats line reports 0 B/s, ETA - while transferred stays frozen between completions (median 7s, p95 36s, max 161s in the 3h production run); the uncommitted 5s derived-speed hold (internal/backup/progress.go derivedSpeedHold) covers only 41.5% of stats ticks in the unknown-backup large-file regime vs 97.4% in music, so speed/ETA are hidden most of the time and the card shows 0 B/s / "—". Recommended minimal fix: rolling ~120s window derivation (speed = transferred delta / window span, keep displaying while any increase is inside the window, honest decay to 0 when quiet exceeds the window, existing percent>=100/counter-reset/finishJob clears unchanged); cheapest alternative is raising derivedSpeedHold to 90-120s (one constant, ~97-99% coverage, but a magic constant tied to file-size distribution and up to 2min stale speed on a true stall).
